entities.name: Animal A

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person with short brown hair, wearing purple long sleeves, a burgundy sleeveless top, gray-brown trousers, and black shoes.

entities.name: gray street surface

entities.name: dark-gray tiled roof
entities.identification: The dark-gray sloped roof in the lower part of the image, covered with rows of staggered rectangular tiles.

entities.name: rooftop chimney
entities.identification: The top of the chimney on the right side of the foreground roof, with a gray cap and two brown flue pipes with curved tops.

entities.name: green median grass
entities.identification: The light-green grassy area at the top of the image, with patches of darker and lighter green on its surface, adjoining the light-colored curb.

entities.name: wooden bench
entities.identification: The brown wooden-plank bench on the grass, with a long seat, a horizontal backrest, and dark legs.

entities.name: dark-green post
entities.identification: The dark-green upright column on the grass, of which only the lower portion is visible, with a thicker base section that is nearly black.

entities.name: blue puddle
entities.identification: The flat light-blue area on the road surface at the upper left, with an irregular boundary and partially extending beyond the image.

entities.name: object illustration bubble
entities.identification: The white circular prompt bubble above Person A's head, containing a pale-yellow-and-blue illustration similar to Object A.

entities.name: light-colored curb
entities.identification: The segmented beige-gray narrow strip extending along the boundary between the grass and the gray road surface.

entities.name: white short-line prompt
entities.identification: The three white radial short-line graphics above Animal A's head in the image.
